residential_colleges.name: Residential Colleges
residential_colleges.summary: Dunham features daily rotating hot entrees, vegan specialties, and breakfast hot line. Headington hosts made-to-order omelets & breakfast sandwiches, specialty bars, and everyday classics.

couch_restaurants.name: Couch Restaurants
couch_restaurants.summary: The legendary OU dining center with The Breakfast Club (eggs, biscuits & gravy, waffles), the world’s only all-you-care-to-eat Chick-fil-A, Shanghai Stir-Fry, Chef’s Choice, and Crimson Creamery.

wagner_dining_hall.name: Wagner Dining Hall
wagner_dining_hall.summary: High-performance nutrition featuring daily made-to-order eggs & waffles, rotating hot breakfast scrambles & pancakes, scratch-made lunch/dinner entrees, and custom kitchens.
